cohort: 8,417,607 births, including 6,068 births to women with RA
finding: Pregnant women with rheumatoid arthritis are at increased risk for various adverse maternal outcomes (pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, gestational diabetes, PPROM, placental abruption, placenta previa, cesarean section, wound complications, thromboembolisms) and neonatal outcomes (congenital anomalies, small for gestational age, preterm birth).
mod_finding: Women with RA were more likely to deliver by caesarean section.
